content:
FoC – Future of Construction is a SIAC project led by BUILT CoLAB that aims to define the strategy for the Twin Transition of the AEC sector, based on four structural vectors: Digitalize, Transform, Preserve and Qualify. To this end, it intends to implement a structured action plan that promotes digital transformation, carbon neutrality, the circular economy, innovation circular economy, innovation and the qualification and certification of skills. This conference is the final event of the project, with a presentation of the main results achieved. More information about this project is available on the at https://futureofconstruction.pt/. Project co-financed by COMPETE 2020, through Portugal 2020 and the FEDER.

Main Activities

  • A1.Digitalize - Strategy for the digital transformation of the AEC sector
  • A2.Transform - Incentivo à investigação, desenvolvimento e inovação
  • A3.Preserve - Encouraging research, development and innovation
  • A4.Qualify - Review of the sector's professional categories and certification of skills
